summary: I picked up the previous F-settings fixer's work from WIP commit 951f073be2 and checked each finding against the code, not against its notes. 11 of the 13 findings are fixed in code. F-06 is half done: the missing ⓘ is added, but the Settings visual check is still not D035-aware. F-12 is fixed in code but only checked offscreen. One more caveat: F-01 is covered only by unit tests that go through the real performKeyEquivalent path, not checked in the app. I did not run anything live. wait-idle.sh 900 exited 1 ("Mac in use (idle 0s) after 900s"), so I did not take the lock, build, install or launch the app. I needed no new code edits this session. The tree builds now; an earlier failure in PlayerControls.swift belonged to another area and cleared by itself. Targeted suites pass except 2 tests in MXRVLCBackendTests, which another area's change to VLCServiceBackends.swift broke (details in notesForOthers).
fixed: F-01: MXRKeyboardShortcutsView.swift. keyDown and performKeyEquivalent now share one handle(_:): key repeats are ignored, plain Esc cancels, plain Delete/Forward Delete clear the binding (capture nil), ⌘Q is passed on. ModalCaptureTests now uses window.performKeyEquivalent and passes (Esc, Delete, key repeat, ⌘Q, a normal combo). Not checked in the app: the Mac was in use.

F-02: settings-map.json5 adds displayOffset 1, automaticValue -1, placeholder 'Auto', min 1 / max 100, new help text and mock 0 (shows '1'). SettingsCatalog gains displayOffset and automaticValue; SettingsModel converts both ways and adds setAutomatic. In SettingsControls, an empty field writes -1 and 'Auto' is drawn in fgA4. SettingsUnitsAuditRegressionTests.testDefaultTrackRowsShowOneBasedTracksAndAutoForMinusOne passes. Render: scratchpad/final/F-settings/playback/side-by-side.png

F-03: SettingsExtensionsView.swift has no reason texts and no dead Find/Add/Remove buttons; an operation this build cannot do is not shown. Remove is disabled only while nothing is selected. A script that can be neither enabled nor run shows no control. The D035/D039 conflict is written up for the owner in DECISIONS D045 (proposed). Render: F-settings/extensions-unavailable.png
F-04: the 'Find more extensions' catalog is now ExtensionCatalogPanel inside .mxrPopup(surface: .contextMenu), with no arrowed NSPopover.

F-05: SubtitleFolderRules.swift keeps only the cancellation checks around the directory read, deletes isAutodetected, and reads the legacy 'files' map once into fileSelections without writing it again. DialogInput.swift replaces the actor with a private serial DispatchQueue plus a continuation and a cancellation handler. SubtitleLookupCancellationTests and SubtitlePersistenceRegressionTests pass.

F-06 (partial): 'When playback finishes' now has its ⓘ ('What happens after the last item in the queue.'), matching Figma; visible in playback/side-by-side.png. The extensions-unavailable gallery notes are updated.
F-07: MediaInfoDialogs.swift shows Location as a ~-abbreviated path with a 'Show in Finder' button for files, and as decoded text for other sources.

F-08: in MXRDialogHost.swift the content behind the scrim gets .accessibilityHidden plus mxrKeyboardFocusSuspended, so it leaves VoiceOver and the Tab order. I did not use .disabled, which would dim the chrome under the scrim. DialogIsolationTests passes.

F-09: in MXRProfilesView the row menu is a design .mxrContextMenu. Delete… now asks first ('Delete Profile “X”?' / 'Its settings and player layout are removed.'), and confirming also calls the new LayoutStore.removeLayouts(profileID:). ProfileDeletionTests passes.

F-11: a device hot-plug now sends SettingsEvent.devicesChanged instead of .reloaded. AppModel ignores it, so profiles.json is no longer rewritten. SettingsModel.deviceChoices is a pure read; loadDeviceChoices(for:) runs from MXRSettingsView .task(id:) for the device kinds on screen. SettingsBackendEventTests.testDeviceHotPlugIsADeviceEventNotASettingsReload and DeviceDiscoveryTests pass.

F-12: MXRDialogSurface (DialogSupport.swift) uses the opaque form of the tint in Light only, for Settings, Keyboard Shortcuts, Add Subtitles and the shared DialogShell. Recorded as a D032 addendum in D045. Shipping-window render F-settings/app-settings-light-final.png shows a clean opaque light pane with no cone showing through. Not confirmed in the real window (Mac in use).
F-13: AppModel+Preferences windowTitle drops the extension or uses the parsed title, and windowTitleFileName keeps the full name (D042). SettingsWorkflowTests passes.
F-14: the four apply:{live:'playlist'} entries are removed and the SettingsCatalog comment says the bridge applies playlist order options live by option name.

notFixed.why: Making mxr-snapshot check D035-aware needs per-entry compare regions in GalleryEntry and the comparison tool (MXRGalleryCatalog/GalleryCatalog.swift and the snapshot tool). Both belong to another area. S48.Settings/playback still FAILs (6.83%), mostly from the D035-removed 'Pause when another app uses audio' row shifting the rows below it and the D030 default 'Ask' against Figma's 'Always'. The 'D035-aware' rule this needs still has to be chosen and built.
wait-idle.sh 900 exited 1 ('Mac in use (idle 0s) after 900s'), so the live part was skipped as the rules require. I did not take the lock and did not build, install or launch the app.
